description: Search Qumge's paid apps — hosted services an agent can call, billed per call from the user's Qumge balance. Use this when the user wants something done rather than a skill to install: 'make a promo video', 'transcribe this call'. Returns the best few with pricing, measured success rate and latency, and the slug to pass to get_app.

limit.description: How many to return. Default 5, max 10.

query.description: What the user wants done, in their own words. Omit to browse the most-used apps.

qumge_key.description: Optional: your Qumge API key, for clients that cannot set an Authorization header. Takes precedence over the header. Never echoed back.

name: search_apps
